name: Hierarchical Volume Traversal with Adaptive Termination
aliases: Combined Hierarchical Enumeration and Adaptive Termination
definition: A ray tracing algorithm that uses a pyramidal data structure of binary volumes to skip empty regions and an adaptive termination criterion to stop tracing when opacity changes become negligible.
summary: Hierarchical Volume Traversal with Adaptive Termination is a ray tracing algorithm using a pyramidal binary volume structure to skip empty regions and adaptively terminate early when opacity changes are negligible.
